hero_eyebrow: Welcome to the Embodied Robotic Intelligence laboratory
hero_description: ERILab at KIST develops embodied intelligence for humanoid robots. Our research connects vision, touch, learning, and control, focusing on loco-manipulation, dexterous hands, and efficient on-device intelligence.
hero_caption: A 3D view of the ERILab research environment.
home_research_intro: We connect vision, touch, learning, and control to help robots move and interact with the physical world.
